title: Route-Model Performance Mural — compact cards, latency bands & token spectrum
creator: Ava Morales
description: Design a compact, scannable 'mural' view for per-model and per-route performance that surfaces latency quantiles, throughput, token-stage distributions, and per-token cost attribution. This ticket covers UX flows, chart specifications, accessibility constraints, and an interactive prototype for stakeholder review. The mural is intended as the default compact entry point in the Redwood Console route and model lists; users should be able to scan health, open a drill panel for microtraces, and compare two versions side-by-side.
acceptance_criteria: Figma screens for the mural primary state, expanded drill flyout, and compare mode delivered
Interactive prototype (time-range + compare + drill) uploaded and clickable by reviewers
Chart specs provided as a single reference doc: latency quantiles (p50/p90/p99 bands), throughput sparkline, token-stage stacked waterfall, and per-token cost waterfall
Engineering checklist: all visual encodings mapped to telemetry fields and data availability validated with ENG-8270 and ENG-8345
Accessibility: color palette meets 4.5:1 contrast for key severity indicators and all interactive controls keyboard-navigable
comments: 2025-01-22 — Ava Morales: Initial brief and goals posted. Focus on compactness for list views, progressive disclosure into a right-side drill panel for microtraces and cost breakdown. Emphasize token-stage waterfall (prompt, generation, post-processing).

2025-01-24 — Liam Chen: Early engineering sync — confirmed telemetry availability for p50/p90/p99 and token-stage counts; KV-cache prefix sizes not yet instrumented (dependency ENG-8345). We'll sample token stage for first pass (1 in 100 requests) to keep metric volume low.
2025-01-28 — PM review (Sofia Patel): Suggest adding an explicit 'cost-efficiency' mini KPI (tokens/latency bucket) and a compare toggle to evaluate rollout candidates.

2025-02-03 — Design critique: Move severity color from background to a 4px left accent to preserve legibility in compact rows. Replace tiny bar charts with sparklines with hover tooltips to support mobile widths.

2025-02-06 — Eng feedback (Ravi Singh): Proposed downsampling for throughput sparkline and server-side pre-aggregation for latency quantiles. Raised a caveat: p99 computed from approximate histogram produced by the runtime; add a small note in tooltip so customers understand estimation.

2025-02-10 — Accessibility pass (Maya Ortiz): Confirmed contrast adjustments and keyboard flow for drill panel. Suggested larger hit targets for compare toggle and a persistent keyboard shortcut to open the last-drilled model.

2025-02-12 — Stakeholder demo: PM and SRE accepted layout; asked for explicit rollback CTA in the drill panel and an opt-in cost details expansion. Next: finalize chart spec doc and handoff PRD to ENG.
2025-02-12 — Next steps assigned: finalize chart encodings, create GH PR template for telemetry field mapping, and schedule a follow-up sync with ENG-8270 on 2025-02-14.
